name: DENC3LOINCConceptMap
title: DEN.C3 ConceptMap to LOINC
description: Candidate terminology mappings for DEN.C3 local concepts to LOINC. Mappings are inexact/narrower and require terminology review; unsupported concepts are explicitly unmapped.

text.div:
Mappings are candidate relationships from the source data dictionary and secondary mapping workbook. They are not independently terminology-validated. Inexact and narrower relations intentionally avoid claiming exact equivalence.

  • hypotensive-shock: The source marks this concept not classifiable in LOINC.
  • severe-bleeding: Source-listed candidate does not exactly match the response concept Severe bleeding; validate suitability.
  • severe-organ-impairment: The source marks this concept not classifiable in LOINC.
  • no-danger-sign: The source marks this concept not classifiable in LOINC.
  • oral-fluid-intake-volume: Secondary mapping workbook proposes this code, while the data dictionary lists 2595931.0. The 24-hour period is not specified in the data dictionary; resolve both issues.
